description: This file defines the SearchIndex class used for managing a searchable index with methods for adding data, searching, and serialization, as part of the typeahead.js library.

classes.name: SearchIndex
classes.description: A class for creating and managing a searchable index with tokenization and trie-based search capabilities.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes the index with existing datums and trie structure.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds data items to the index, tokenizing and inserting them into the trie.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves data items by their IDs.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches the index for data matching the query tokens.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns all data items in the index.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the index to an empty state.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the index to a plain object.
